question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in the United States, with voltage level, operator and status?

answer.summary: No national government layer of US line routes is live: DHS's HIFLD Open, still cited by EIA, was withdrawn in 2025. An Esri archive (data to 2024-09-30) keeps 94,619 transmission segments (about 69 kV+) with voltage, owner and status, though many are inferred or blank. Distribution routes exist only per utility (tested: National Grid NY, 1,913 feeders). California's CEC publishes a current official layer (6,838 segments, with proposed lines). OpenStreetMap adds uneven operator/voltage tags. No national planned-lines layer was found.
main_caveats: HIFLD Open (DHS) was sunset in 2025; the usable copy is an Esri archive with data to 2024-09-30, no longer updated, while EIA's FAQ still points to HIFLD.
Counts are line segments (polyline features), not circuits or route-km; 59,111 of 94,619 HIFLD segments are flagged INFERRED=Y.
HIFLD attributes are incomplete: no OWNER 17,990, no STATUS 20,819, VOLTAGE<=0 14,248. OWNER is not a verified operator.
Distribution geometry is utility by utility; only National Grid NY (1,913 feeders) was tested.
Planned lines are not systematic: HIFLD has no planned class; CEC's 14 'Proposed' lines include stale 2014-era entries.
OpenStreetMap completeness is uneven and the public Overpass server returned 406/502 errors during tests.
answer.confidence_reason: Layers and fields were queried on 2026-11-20; the 2025 HIFLD sunset rests on secondary pages (no DHS notice opened); utility and RTO coverage beyond the examples was not checked.

attributes.note: Polylines: 94,619 HIFLD transmission segments; distribution only per utility (National Grid NY 1,913 feeders).
attributes.gap_note: No national distribution layer found; only one utility's feeders were tested, other utilities' hosting-capacity maps were not opened. 59,111 HIFLD segments are inferred routes.

attributes.note: HIFLD VOLTAGE (kV), CEC kV, National Grid feeder_voltage; OSM voltage in volts.
attributes.gap_note: HIFLD has VOLTAGE<=0 in 14,248 of 94,619 segments and VOLT_CLASS 'NOT AVAILABLE' in 8,822; OSM voltage tags are optional.

attributes.note: HIFLD OWNER, CEC Owner, National Grid operating_company, OSM operator tag; names not harmonised.
attributes.gap_note: HIFLD OWNER is 'NOT AVAILABLE' in 17,990 of 94,619 segments and is ownership, not operator; OSM operator present on 133 of 343 ways in one test box.

attributes.note: HIFLD STATUS (IN SERVICE, INACTIVE, UNDER CONSTRUCTION); CEC Operational/Proposed/Closed; planned only in fragments.
attributes.gap_note: HIFLD STATUS is 'NOT AVAILABLE' in 20,819 segments, has 25 under construction and no planned class; planned layers from RTOs/ISOs (PJM, MISO, CAISO, BPA) were not opened.

sources.name: U.S. Electric Power Transmission Lines (Archive) - HIFLD data
sources.publisher: Esri (Federal_User_Community, Esri U.S. Federal Datasets); data originally from DHS HIFLD Open
sources.format: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer (JSON, GeoJSON, shapefile, GeoPackage, CSV exports)
sources.license: Esri Master License Agreement (item licenseInfo); accessInformation: U.S. Government
sources.summary: Esri-hosted archive of the DHS HIFLD national transmission-line layer: 94,619 polyline segments with voltage, owner, status and end substations, queryable as an open ArcGIS service.
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide transmission (about 69 kV and above); no distribution lines; data currency 2024-09-30; not updated since.
caveats: Archived, no further updates; original DHS HIFLD Open withdrawn in 2025.
59,111 segments are inferred routes; 14,248 have no voltage, 17,990 no owner, 20,819 no status.

problems: The original DHS HIFLD Open hub could not be tested: the hub pages are a JavaScript app and DHS withdrew the portal in 2025.
Layer has no copyright or description text of its own; provenance comes from the item page.

example.example_request: curl -G 'https://services2.arcgis.com/FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3/arcgis/rest/services/US_Electric_Power_Transmission_Lines/FeatureServer/0/query' --data-urlencode "where=VOLT_CLASS='735 AND ABOVE' AND STATUS='IN SERVICE'" --data-urlencode 'outFields=*' --data-urlencode 'resultRecordCount=2' --data-urlencode 'outSR=4326' --data-urlencode 'f=geojson'
example.example_result: 2 LineString features; e.g. ID 100170: OWNER APPALACHIAN POWER CO, VOLTAGE 765, VOLT_CLASS 735 AND ABOVE, SUB_1 CLOVERDALE 765KV, SUB_2 JACKSONS FERRY, STATUS IN SERVICE, INFERRED N, 56 vertices from (-80.823, 36.879).

sources.name: California Electric Transmission Lines (TransmissionLine_CEC)
sources.format: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layer 2 (JSON, GeoJSON; Extract enabled)
sources.license: California Energy Commission Conditions of Use (item licenseInfo links https://www.energy.ca.gov/conditions-of-use); terms not reviewed in detail
sources.summary: California Energy Commission's own transmission line layer: 6,838 segments with kV, owner, circuit, overhead/underground type and a last-reported status that includes proposed and closed lines.
sources.coverage_note: California only; layer edited 2026-10-29; no stated update schedule.
caveats: Status is last reported; 14 'Proposed' lines include 2014-era entries.

problems: Terms of use page was downloaded but its text was not reviewed.
Layer 0 returns error 400: the layer id is 2.

example.example_result: 3 LineString features, e.g. Name 'ESJ 500kV', kV 500, Owner ESJ, Status Proposed, Circuit Single, Type OH, Source DUDEK, Comments 'To be operated by fall 2014' (a stale status).

sources.name: Local Feeder Level Hosting Capacity for PV (NYSDP Hosting_Capacity_Data, layer 0)
sources.publisher: National Grid (New York System Data Portal)
sources.summary: National Grid publishes 1,913 New York distribution feeders as polylines with feeder voltage and operating company through an open ArcGIS service.
sources.coverage_note: One utility, New York State only; example of utility-level distribution geometry, not a national source.
caveats: Single utility; other utilities not tested.

problems: No license or description text in the service metadata.

example.example_result: 1 MultiLineString feature (73 vertices): Master_CDF 36_30_32752, operating_company National Grid, feeder_voltage 13.2, nyiso_load_zone F, substation McKOWNVILLE TB 2, hca_refresh_date 2026-03-31.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap power lines (power=line) via Overpass API
sources.format: OSM XML/JSON via Overpass; planet and regional extracts
sources.summary: OpenStreetMap carries nationwide line geometry; many ways have voltage and some operator tags, and lifecycle is encoded in tag prefixes. Queryable through Overpass.
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide but uneven: 133 of 343 power=line ways in one Virginia test box had an operator tag.
caveats: Crowd-sourced; operator and status are incomplete.
Public Overpass server was unreliable during tests.

problems: Several Overpass requests returned 406/502/timeouts; a count of lines with voltage in the same test box could not be obtained.

example.example_result: 2 ways in northern Virginia: way 112389606 voltage 500000, operator Dominion Energy, ref 514, 49 vertices; way 216903476 'Mosby - Brambleton' voltage '500000;230000', operator Virginia Electric & Power Company, 21 vertices.

if_unstructured.summary: Planned lines appear mainly in project documents (ERCOT environmental impact reports, utility project pages referenced in the Texas layer's source field), not as systematic geometry.

local_terms.meaning: Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data, the DHS programme that compiled the public infrastructure layers.
Utility map of distribution feeders showing capacity for distributed generation; a practical source of feeder geometry.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
